While I kinda understand people who don't give a fuck anymore, I cannot see why this is some great virtue, or some great achievement in life. Isn't it rather the losers last defence before depression?
The virtue of not giving a fuck

There are different ways to "not care". Some ways of having no fucks are more enlightened than others. There are a lot of really unimportant things that happen to us, small dramas that actually don't deserve anything but a passing thought. These are appropriate situations to give less if any fucks, Things you can't change...give no fucks. Things you can't influence...also give no fucks. However, this requires the ability to think critically about a situation and objectively determine if effort can produce change. Think of the small dramas as white noise that keep you from focusing on big things. This is why not giving a fuck is liberating because you free up so much energy to worry about really important shit. God damn moments of clarity are awesome!

If you begin to walk the path of no fucks without first having a real soul searching and discovering what you can and cannot contribute to the world, you end up a depressed wreck trapped by delusions of futility. Most everyone has something they can contribute to change the world for the better but it might be something small and it might not make you feel particularly "special".
I have no opinions on your reasons for not giving a fuck as long as your outcome is not retarded I might be willing to listen.
